create_test_lead.description: Create a made-up test lead on a form, to try a workflow without running an ad. Meta usually keeps one test lead per form at a time, so delete the old one before creating another.
create_test_lead.name: create_test_lead

parameters.description: The lead form. Choose it from the list of the connected Page's forms, or give its ID, a long number such as 1234567890123456. List forms returns every form's ID; in Meta, your forms are listed under Instant Forms, in the All tools menu of Ads Manager or Meta Business Suite.
parameters.name: form_id

parameters.description: The answers to give the test lead, as a list with one entry per question, such as [{"name": "email", "values": ["ada@example.com"]}]. Each name is a question's key (Get form lists them). Leave blank and Meta fills in sample answers.
parameters.name: field_data

schema.description: The answers to give the test lead, as a list with one entry per question, such as [{"name": "email", "values": ["ada@example.com"]}]. Each name is a question's key (Get form lists them). Leave blank and Meta fills in sample answers.

id.description: The new test lead's ID. Get lead and Delete test lead take it.

delete_test_lead.description: Delete a test lead, so another can be created on its form. Leads from real people can't be deleted with this.
delete_test_lead.name: delete_test_lead

parameters.description: The test lead's ID, as returned by Create test lead or List test leads.
parameters.name: lead_id

success.description: True when the test lead was deleted.

description: Retrieve Facebook and Instagram lead ad submissions, manage lead forms and create test leads.

meta_lead_ads_new_form_trigger.description: Runs each time a new lead form (Instant Form) is created on the connected Facebook Page. In beta, it hands over the form's form_id, form_name and status ready to use. Forms already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch a Page with up to 4,000 forms. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.created: Beta. When the form was created, as a date and time in UTC, such as 2026-11-10T18:02:11+00:00.
output.form_id: Beta. The new form's ID, a long number. Get form and List leads take it.
output.form_name: Beta. The form's name, as shown in Meta.
output.record: The form exactly as Meta sends it, for workflows saved before the fields beside it existed. Prefer those.
output.status: Beta. The form's state: ACTIVE, ARCHIVED or DRAFT.

meta_lead_ads_new_lead_trigger.description: Runs each time someone fills in the chosen Facebook or Instagram lead form. In beta, it hands over their full_name, email, phone and every answer (answers) ready to use, so no step is needed to pick them out of Meta's raw data. Leads already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch a form with up to 4,000 leads. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.
